description: Defines an interface for building responses and events related to modifying attributes in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for ModifyAttribute commands.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects related to ModifyAttribute.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by ModifyAttribute commands.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a 'created' response or event based on the command.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a 'modified' response or event based on the command.

methods.name: attributeNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Builds an error response indicating the attribute was not accessible.

methods.name: attributeNotModifiableError
methods.description: Builds an error response indicating the attribute was not modifiable.
